units.source_text: 农村寺庙住持之死，可以说是非同一般，是有点过分的、异常的。

en.t: The death of the abbot of a rural temple was, one might say, no ordinary matter; it was somewhat excessive, something abnormal.

units.source_text: 可以说他是这地方的精神支柱，是当地信徒各自生涯的保护人，同时也是他们死后可以依托的人。

en.t: He could be called the spiritual pillar of the place, the guardian of each local believer's life, and at the same time the person on whom they could rely after death.

units.source_text: 这样一个地，在寺庙死去了，给人这样一种感觉：

en.t: When such a figure died in the temple, it gave people this impression:

units.source_text: 简直像一位非常忠于职守的、非常出色的人，一位到处将死的方法施教于人的人，在亲自示范表演时失误而造成死亡似的。

en.t: It was almost as if an exceptionally dutiful and outstanding man, someone who went everywhere teaching people how to die, had made a mistake and died while personally demonstrating it.

units.source_text: 人们觉得这是一种过失。

en.t: People felt that it was a kind of error.
